problems.title: Level With Maximum Nodes in an N-ary Tree

numeric_complexity_contract.reference: rebuild parent links and find every node's level by walking its parent chain to the root, then count per level
numeric_complexity_contract.candidate_design: parse the level-order list once, counting nodes per level breadth-first; keep the first level whose count beats the best so far

numeric_complexity_contract.reference: score every pair of rows with Fraction arithmetic and keep the pairs reaching the threshold
numeric_complexity_contract.candidate_design: convert weights and threshold to integer ten-thousandths; bucket rows by (field, value) so each row adds its shared-field weights to a score array of later rows, then scan the array against the threshold
numeric_complexity_contract.complexity_target: O(n^2 + n * fields) time/O(n * fields) space

numeric_complexity_contract.reference: score every pair with Fraction arithmetic, then propagate the smallest row label across linked pairs until nothing changes

numeric_complexity_contract.complexity_target: O(n^2 alpha(n) + n * fields) time/O(n * fields) space

numeric_complexity_contract.reference: for each row, score every other row with Fraction arithmetic and take the maximum of (score, -row) among linked rows

numeric_complexity_contract.complexity_target: O(n^2 + n * fields) time/O(n * fields) space

numeric_complexity_contract.reference: fixed-point relaxation: recompute every service's load as the sum of its callers' loads (plus 1 for entry) until nothing changes
numeric_complexity_contract.candidate_design: Kahn topological order with a queue over the whole graph, pushing each service's load to its callees once its own load is final; sort names at the end
numeric_complexity_contract.complexity_target: O(V log V + E) time/O(V + E) space

numeric_complexity_contract.reference: interval recursion: s[i:j] is valid when s[i] opens a pair closed at some k whose content is valid and holds no higher-ranked opener, followed by a valid rest; take the longest valid substring
numeric_complexity_contract.candidate_design: one stack pass: each open frame remembers its position and the highest rank of pairs closed inside it; a matching closer with an allowed rank pops the frame and measures back to the next frame or the last barrier, anything else resets the stack at a barrier

numeric_complexity_contract.reference: for t from the largest possible down, test the assignment with augmenting-path maximum flow (source to nodes with capacity t, node to type 1, type to sink its count)
numeric_complexity_contract.candidate_design: count each type with a hash map; a type can serve at most min(count, m) nodes, and t per node is feasible exactly when the sum of min(count, m) is at least m * t (the counting function is concave), so t = floor(sum / m)
